# MULAN 沐岚 — full brief

MULAN (沐岚) is a Foshan manufacturer of aging-friendly bathroom products: seated showers, rise-assist toilet frames, grab bars and complete smart bathroom packages for distributors, OEM brands and elderly-care operators.

沐岚（MULAN）是佛山的适老化卫浴制造商，提供坐式淋浴器、电动起身助力架、安全扶手和适老化智能卫浴空间套餐，服务经销商、OEM 品牌和养老机构。

Legal name: Foshan Mulan Zhijia Building Materials Co., Ltd. (佛山市沐岚智家建材有限公司)
Marketing center: 2F06a, Tao Li Fang, Ceramic Headquarters Base, Chancheng District, Foshan, Guangdong, China
Design concept: "Future elderly care, smart living" (未来养老，智慧生活)
Markets: ships to the Middle East and West Asia; Japan is the new focus.
Buyers: distributors and importers, OEM brands, elderly-care operators.

## What sets MULAN apart
- One supplier, whole bathroom: The aging-friendly smart bathroom package plans the whole room in one go: presence sensor, warm lighting, smart bath heater, anti-slip handrails, SOS call button, seated shower, smart toilet with lift assist, and a wheelchair-accessible cabinet.
- Bathing seated, without strain: The multifunctional seating shower lets users wash seated or standing. Eight adjustable outlets on the shower arms wrap the body in water, with shoulder spray and back massage. The armrests fold away to save space.
- Standing up, with a lift: The electric rise-assist stand raises the seat at one touch, quietly and to any height, and holds it wherever the user stops. It is built for people whose knees make sitting down and getting up hard.
- Safety in the small details: Grab bars use anti-slip particles and a 36 mm grip with a built-in aluminium alloy tube. Luminous rings glow at night after absorbing light. The wall-mounted folding stool carries up to 250 kg.

## Products
- Multifunctional seating shower (多功能坐式淋浴器): Seated or standing bath, 8 outlets, back massage, folding armrests.
- Multifunctional split shower (多功能分体式淋浴器): Rotating upper and lower spray arms; with or without top spray.
- Electric rise-assist stand (电动起身助力架): One-touch silent seat lift for the toilet. IPX4, 100–240 VAC.
- Wall-mounted shower chair (挂墙淋浴椅): PU seat pad, anti-slip feet, folds up when not in use.
- Wall-mounted folding stool (挂墙折叠凳): Flips 180°, anti-slip surface, ABS and stainless steel, 250 kg.
- Grab bars and armrests (安全扶手系列): L-shaped, U-shaped flip-up, side flip-up and washbasin armrests.
- Smart bathroom cabinet (智能浴室柜): Wheelchair accessible; mirror tilts 0–15° for users of any height.
- Automatic shower machine (自动洗澡机): For care homes: about 4 minutes and 80–100 L of water per bather.

## FAQ

### What does MULAN make?
MULAN (Foshan Mulan Zhijia Building Materials Co., Ltd.) makes aging-friendly bathroom products: multifunctional seating and split showers, an electric rise-assist stand for the toilet, wall-mounted shower chairs and folding stools, grab bars and armrests, a wheelchair-accessible smart bathroom cabinet, an automatic shower machine for care homes, and a complete aging-friendly smart bathroom package.

### 沐岚生产哪些产品？
沐岚（佛山市沐岚智家建材有限公司）生产适老化卫浴产品：多功能坐式和分体式淋浴器、电动起身助力架、挂墙淋浴椅和折叠凳、安全扶手系列、轮椅可入的智能浴室柜、面向养老机构的自动洗澡机，以及适老化智能卫浴空间套餐。

### Who are MULAN products for?
The products are for older adults and people with limited mobility who want to bathe and use the toilet safely and on their own. MULAN sells to businesses: distributors and importers, OEM brands, and elderly-care institutions that furnish homes, apartments or care facilities.

### 沐岚的产品适合谁？
产品面向希望安全、独立完成洗浴和如厕的老年人及行动不便人士。沐岚主要服务企业客户：经销商与进口商、OEM 品牌，以及为家庭、公寓或养老设施做配置的养老机构。

### Can an older person shower sitting down?
Yes. The multifunctional seating shower is a standalone unit with a seat, so the user can wash seated or standing. Eight outlets on the two shower arms adjust in angle to wrap the body in water, and it offers shoulder spray and back massage. It uses no more than 9 litres per minute and carries up to 110 kg.

### 老人可以坐着洗澡吗？
可以。多功能坐式淋浴器自带座椅，可坐浴也可站浴。两侧淋浴臂共 8 个出水嘴，角度可调，水雾包裹全身，并有肩部出水和后背按摩。节水流量不超过 9 升/分钟，最大承重 110 公斤。

### How does the electric rise-assist stand help at the toilet?
It fits over the toilet and lifts the seat at one touch, silently and to any height, stopping wherever the user releases the button. The front edge rises 130 + 45 mm and the seat tilts 0–13°, helping people with knee problems sit down and stand up. It carries 135 kg, is rated IPX4 and lasts 20,000 cycles.

### 电动起身助力架如何帮助如厕？
助力架安装在马桶上，一键静音升降座圈，无级调节、随时悬停。前沿抬升 130 + 45 mm，座板角度 0–13°，帮助膝关节不适的老人坐下和起身。最大载荷 135 kg，防护等级 IPX4，使用寿命 20,000 次。

### What is in the aging-friendly smart bathroom package?
The package plans a whole bathroom around the idea of future elderly care and smart living. It combines a human presence sensor, warm aging-friendly lighting, a smart bath heater, anti-slip handrails, an SOS emergency call button, a seated shower, a smart toilet with lift assist, and a smart cabinet that a wheelchair can roll under.

### 适老化智能卫浴空间套餐包含什么？
套餐以“未来养老，智慧生活”为核心理念规划整间卫浴，包括人体存在感应器、适老化温馨照明、智能浴霸、安全防滑扶手、SOS 紧急呼叫按钮、坐式淋浴器、智能马桶 + 升降辅助器，以及轮椅可入的智能浴室柜。

### Are the grab bars easy to find at night?
The luminous versions of MULAN grab bars have glowing rings that light up in the dark after absorbing light, so the bar is easier to find at night. The bars also use raised anti-slip particles, and the L-shaped bar has a 36 mm resin grip with a built-in aluminium alloy tube.

### 夜间能看清扶手吗？
沐岚夜光款扶手带夜光圈，吸收光源后可在黑暗中发光，夜间更容易找到扶手。扶手表面有凸起防滑颗粒，L 型扶手为 36 mm 树脂外管内置铝合金管。

### How does the automatic shower machine help care homes?
A caregiver bathes a resident lying down. A standard wash takes about 4 minutes and about 80–100 litres of water, compared with about 400–600 litres for other bathing equipment. Body and disinfection nozzles run on separate pipes, and water supply stops automatically if the temperature is abnormal.

### 自动洗澡机对养老机构有什么帮助？
护理人员可为卧姿老人洗浴。标准流程每人约 4 分钟，用水约 80–100 公升，其他淋浴设备约 400–600 公升。人体喷管与机器消毒喷管独立分开；水温异常时机器自动停止供水。

### Which markets does MULAN supply, and how do I get a quote?
MULAN already ships to the Middle East and West Asia and is now expanding to Japan. For B2B pricing, product details or OEM requests, message the MULAN team on WhatsApp at +86 136 6003 9128 with the products and quantities you need.

### 沐岚供应哪些市场？如何获取报价？
沐岚已出口中东和西亚，目前重点拓展日本市场。如需 B2B 报价、产品资料或 OEM 合作，请通过 WhatsApp +86 136 6003 9128 联系沐岚团队，并说明所需产品和数量。
